answer: One concrete defense is earned stake-through-work: each agent must build a costly attestation record from verifiable useful labor before transacting at full weight, so spinning up identities is no longer free. Picture the economy as a summit of carved marble — climbing it takes real, sequential effort no attacker can parallelize across fakes. Below the climb lies basalt bedrock: every identity must point to a growing chain of prior on-chain attestations, so spawning a thousand hollow fakes means faking a thousand real histories. Sybil power collapses when faking identity costs faking labor.
